name: typescript-to-gml
description: GameMaker declarations and a TypeScript-to-GML compiler.
author: Rhemery

scripts.build: npm run build:code --silent && npm run bundle --silent
scripts.package:yymps: npm run build --silent && npm run build:yymps --silent
scripts.declarations: npm run build:code --silent && node dist/src/cli.js declarations && npm run bundle --silent
scripts.verify:release: npm run check --silent && npm test --silent && npm run build:yymps --silent && npm run smoke:distribution --silent
scripts.verify: npm run declarations --silent && npm run check:runtime-types --silent && npm run verify:release --silent && npm run example --silent && npm run check:game --silent && npm run smoke:gamemaker --silent
scripts.example: npm run build --silent && node scripts/install-example.mjs && node TestProject/datafiles/ts2gml/cli.cjs build TestProject/TestProject.yyp
